keywords.def: (slang) adult who likes buying and playing with toys and games intended for children
toy dolls or animals made from cloth and filled with soft material stuffing
money left over, after paying all your expenses, for you to buy whatever you like
the part of your adult personality that still emotionally feels and reacts like a child
(idiom) have free time and nothing to do with it

sentences.en: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好，这里是BBC英语教学的《6 Minute English》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Phil. And I'm Beth. Action figures, building bricks, stuffed cuddly animals – there's a whole world of toys that many of us have forgotten since we were children.
sentences.zh: 我是Phil。我是Beth。动作玩偶、积木、毛绒玩具——有这样一个丰富多彩的玩具世界，许多人自从童年以后就再没关注过了。

sentences.en: Do you still have any toys from when you were a boy, Phil?
sentences.zh: Phil，你还留着小时候的玩具吗？

sentences.en: Erm, a couple, but I gave them to my kids.
sentences.zh: 呃，还留着几个，不过我都送给我的孩子了。

sentences.en: Well, nowadays, grown-ups playing with toys is more common than you might think.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如今成年人玩玩具比你想象的还要常见。

sentences.en: Recent estimates suggest that adults buying kids' toys for themselves account for between 30 and 40% of the entire toy market, so many that advertisers have come up with a term for them: kidults – adults who are interested in toys and games intended for children.
sentences.zh: 最近的估计表明，成年人给自己买儿童玩具占了整个玩具市场的30%到40%，数量之多以至于广告商专门为他们创造了一个词：kidult（大儿童）——指对儿童玩具和游戏感兴趣的成年人。

sentences.en: Between last October and December alone, American kidults spent over 1.5 billion dollars on toys for themselves.
sentences.zh: 仅在去年10月到12月期间，美国的大儿童们就为自己购买玩具花费了超过15亿美元。

sentences.en: Among the most popular were plush toys, or plushies for short – toy dolls or animals made from cloth and filled with soft material.
sentences.zh: 其中最受欢迎的是毛绒玩具，简称为plushies——即用布料制作并填充有柔软材质的玩偶或动物玩具。

sentences.en: And like other recent trends, the toy trend is being driven by online shoppers and social media.
sentences.zh: 和其他最新潮流一样，这股玩具潮流也是由网购消费者和社交媒体推动的。

sentences.en: In this episode, we'll meet a children's toy maker and an online influencer who are both involved in the increasing trend of adults interested in kids' toys.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将采访一位儿童玩具制造商和一位网络红人，他们都参与了成年人对儿童玩具日益增长的这股潮流。

sentences.en: We'll also learn some useful new vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 我们还将学习一些实用的新词汇。

sentences.en: And remember – you'll find a transcript for this episode, along with all the new words and phrases, on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 请记住——你可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到本期节目的文稿，以及所有的新单词和短语。

sentences.en: But first I have a question for you, Beth.
sentences.zh: 但首先我有一个问题要问你，Beth。

sentences.en: Lego remains one of the most popular, and expensive, children's toys.
sentences.zh: 乐高依然是最受欢迎且最昂贵的儿童玩具之一。

sentences.en: So, according to MSN News, what was the most expensive Lego set ever made?
sentences.zh: 那么，根据MSN新闻报道，史上最贵的乐高套装是什么？

sentences.en: Was it: a) the Lego Harry Potter Hogwarts School, b) the Lego Star Wars Millennium Falcon, or c) the Lego Eiffel Tower?
sentences.zh: 选项是：a) 乐高哈利波特霍格沃茨学校，b) 乐高星球大战千年隼，还是 c) 乐高埃菲尔铁塔？

sentences.en: I'm going to guess Hogwarts because I like Harry Potter.
sentences.zh: 我猜是霍格沃茨，因为我喜欢哈利波特。

sentences.en: OK. Well, we'll find out the answer later in the programme.
sentences.zh: 好的。嗯，我们会在节目后面揭晓答案。

sentences.en: Lisa Lee is a toy maker based in Vancouver and the owner of Leather Monsters, a brand of leather plushies which she advertises online.
sentences.zh: Lisa Lee是一位居住在温哥华的玩具制造商，也是皮革毛绒玩具品牌Leather Monsters的创始人，她在网上宣传自己的品牌。

sentences.en: Here, Lisa tells BBC World Service programme Business Daily how she reconnected with her love of toys as an adult: Once I kind of had a stable job with disposable income, I kind of rediscovered my love for soft toys, and I started buying them again because I've always loved collecting things, because, you know, they bring me happiness, they bring me joy.
sentences.zh: 在这里，Lisa向BBC世界频道的节目《商业日报》讲述了她是如何在成年后重新找回对玩具的爱：一旦我有了稳定的工作和可支配收入，我就好像重新发现了自己对毛绒玩具的热爱，我开始再次购买它们，因为我一直喜欢收集东西，因为你知道，它们带给我幸福，带给我快乐。

sentences.en: And I think also a big pillar of my channel and my content is reconnecting with my childhood, and healing that inner child, and I think the toys also play a part in that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我的频道和内容的一个重要支柱是重新连接我的童年，治愈那个内在的小孩，我认为玩具在这其中也发挥了一定的作用。

sentences.en: Lisa started collecting toys as an adult with a job and disposable income.
sentences.zh: Lisa在成年后拥有了工作和可支配收入后开始收集玩具。

sentences.en: Disposable income is the money you have left over after paying all your expenses.
sentences.zh: 可支配收入是指你支付完所有费用后剩下的钱。

sentences.en: You can use it to buy whatever you like.
sentences.zh: 你可以用它来买任何你喜欢的东西。

sentences.en: Soft, cuddly toys make Lisa happy and help her reconnect with her inner child – a term from psychology which describes the part of your adult personality that still feels and reacts like a child.
sentences.zh: 柔软的毛绒玩具让Lisa感到快乐，并帮助她重新连接自己内在的小孩——这是一个心理学术语，描述的是成年人格中仍然像小孩子一样感受和反应的那一部分。

sentences.en: Besides the adults who sell kids' toys are the adults who buy them.
sentences.zh: 除了卖儿童玩具的成年人，还有买儿童玩具的成年人。

sentences.en: Jay Glatfelter is an enthusiastic toy collector and influencer who makes YouTube videos under the name Geek Dad Life.
sentences.zh: Jay Glatfelter是一位热情的玩具收藏家和网红，他在YouTube上以Geek Dad Life的名义制作视频。

sentences.en: Here's Jay talking about the link between Covid lockdowns and the rise in adult toy collecting to BBC World Service's Business Daily: And then what happened was a whole bunch of new collectors kind of jumped into toy collecting.
sentences.zh: 这里是Jay向BBC世界频道的《商业日报》谈论新冠疫情封锁与成年人玩具收藏热潮之间的联系：然后发生的事情是一大批新收藏家涌入玩具收藏领域。

sentences.en: And for those of us that were into it before, we saw the prices – the secondary market prices – like, explode once the pandemic happened, because you had people that had time on their hands, maybe they had extra money because they're not spending it by going out, and now they're putting it into collecting toys.
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些之前就沉迷其中的人来说，我们眼睁睁看着价格——二级市场的价格——在疫情爆发后简直爆炸式增长，因为你发现人们有了大把空闲时间，他们可能有了额外的钱，因为他们不用出门花钱，现在他们把钱投入到了收集玩具中。

sentences.en: During the pandemic, people had time on their hands – an idiom meaning to have a lot of free time and nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间，人们有大把空闲时间——这是一个习语，意思是拥有大量空闲时间却无所事事。

sentences.en: Many adults went online, hoping to find the toys they remembered from childhood.
sentences.zh: 许多成年人上网，希望能找到他们记忆中童年时的玩具。

sentences.en: As a result, a whole bunch – meaning a large number – of people started collecting toys, and slowly but surely demand increased and prices went up.
sentences.zh: 结果，一大批——意思是大批的——人开始收集玩具，慢慢地但毫无疑问地，需求增加，价格也上涨了。

sentences.en: Yes, it seems that the feeling of rediscovering your childhood, reported by many adult toy collectors, comes at a price, with the cost of collectable items, like Pokémon cards and Jellycat plushies, increasing dramatically during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 是的，许多成年玩具收藏家所报告的重新发现童年的感觉似乎是有代价的，像宝可梦卡牌和Jellycat毛绒玩具等收藏品的价格在疫情期间急剧上涨。

sentences.en: And speaking of expensive toys, Phil, isn't it time you reveal the answer to your question?
sentences.zh: 说到昂贵的玩具，Phil，是不是该揭晓你的问题答案了？

sentences.en: Ah, yes. I asked you, "What was the most expensive Lego set ever made?" You said it was the Lego Hogwarts School.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。我问你，“史上最贵的乐高套装是什么？”你说那是乐高霍格沃茨学校。

sentences.en: Well, I'm afraid the answer is actually the Lego Star Wars Millennium Falcon, which had a UK retail price of £734.99, according to MSN news.
sentences.zh: 嗯，恐怕答案实际上是乐高星球大战千年隼，根据MSN新闻报道，它的英国零售价为734.99英镑。

sentences.en: That's crazy! OK. It's time to recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with kidult – an adult who likes playing with toys and games intended for children.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了！好吧。是时候复习我们学过的词汇了，从kidult开始——一个喜欢玩儿童玩具和游戏的成年人。

sentences.en: Plushie is short for plush toy – a toy doll or animal stuffed with a soft cloth filling.
sentences.zh: Plushie是plush toy（毛绒玩具）的简称——一种填充有柔软布料填料的玩偶或动物玩具。

sentences.en: Your disposable income is the amount of money you have left to buy whatever you want after paying your expenses.
sentences.zh: 你的可支配收入是指你支付完费用后，剩下用来买任何你想买的东西的金额。

sentences.en: Someone's inner child refers to the part of their adult personality that still feels and reacts like a child.
sentences.zh: 某人的内在的小孩指的是他们成年人格中仍然像小孩子一样感受和反应的那一部分。

sentences.en: A bunch is a number of things, often a large number of things.
sentences.zh: A bunch是一堆东西，通常指数量很多的东西。

sentences.en: And finally, the idiom to have time on your hands means having free time and nothing much to do with it.
sentences.zh: 最后，“有大把空闲时间”这个习语的意思是拥有自由时间却没有什么事可做。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up, but remember – you'll find episodes about plenty more trending topics, along with a quiz and worksheet for this episode, on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 我们的六分钟节目又到时间了，但请记住——你可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到关于更多热门话题的节目，以及本期节目的小测验和练习页。

sentences.en: See you there soon, but for now it's goodbye.
sentences.zh: 很快再见，但现在节目要结束了。

sentences.en: Bye!
sentences.zh: 再见！
